title: syncbond encrypted sync envelope
description: Wire format (JSON) of an encrypted sync payload, version 1. AEAD: XChaCha20-Poly1305. nonce and ciphertext are base64url without padding. Every field except ciphertext is authenticated as AEAD associated data; the ciphertext bytes are opaque to the SDK.

protocolVersion.description: wire protocol version; receivers must reject mismatches (version negotiation)

groupId.description: sync group identifier; envelopes from other groups are rejected (cross-group protection)

senderDeviceId.description: sending device id, bound into the AEAD

keyEpoch.description: group key epoch; rotation locks out devices holding only older epochs (revocation)

messageId.description: unique per message; receivers reject duplicates (replay protection)

ciphertext.description: base64url of ciphertext || 16-byte Poly1305 tag; minimum covers a 1-byte plaintext
